title: TIFR Visiting Students' Research Programme 2027
summary: About eight weeks (mid-May to early July) of research with TIFR faculty in astronomy, biology, chemistry, computer science, maths or physics.
eligibility: Students who have completed at least two years of UG science or engineering: final-year 3-year BSc; pre-final or final year of 4-year BSc, MSc, integrated MSc, BTech/BE. PhD students and past VSRP participants are not eligible.

prize.description: TIFR Hyderabad's 2026 VSRP paid ₹9,000/month plus shared accommodation and travel reimbursement; check each campus for its rate.

notes: The 2026 deadline was 31 January 2026, with shortlists by mid-March. Expect the 2027 call around December–January.
